# Aman Sinha

> Aman Sinha is a Lead Digital Product Manager, VP at Wells Fargo in Bengaluru, focused on enterprise platforms, AI automation, and measurable product impact.

Aman Sinha has 15+ years across product ownership, platform strategy, engineering, consulting, presales, and enterprise transformation. His portfolio documents work at global scale, including products supporting 200K+ endpoints, 34M+ monthly voice minutes, 100+ engineers across eight teams, and $8M+ in efficiencies and cost avoidance.

- [Cloud modernization](https://amansinha.me/work/cloud-modernization): Product ownership for migrating internal applications from on-premises virtual machines to OpenShift and Kubernetes.
- [Generative AI learning](https://amansinha.me/work/ai-learning): An independent AI-powered learning platform using generative AI to produce personalized educational content.
